acceptance: A scheduled or dispatched refresh opens a pull request whose CI runs without approval, includes a current docs reference inventory, and receives an oracle verdict without a manual dispatch
The next refresh pull request merges with no manual intervention or the remaining manual step is documented with its owner
context:
Progress 2026-10-29: PR 3698 merged (64e13d078). The refresh workflow now regenerates quality/docs-reference-inventory.json in the same commit as the shards and fails with a clear error if the inventory is still stale; workflow tests pin the ordering. It also reuses CROSS_SURFACE_BASELINE_PR_TOKEN (falling back to the workflow token) for the checkout and pull request creation so the pull request's runs and oracle verdict can trigger. OPEN: (1) the owner must confirm that secret exists with scopes to push branches and open pull requests; without it behaviour is unchanged (action_required, no oracle verdict). (2) Nothing was dispatched, so the end-to-end refresh is unverified; the next scheduled run (Mondays 06:17 UTC) or a dispatch should be checked for CI without approval and an oracle verdict. (3) The branch is still cut from develop at run time, so a red develop is inherited.

Seen on the manual dispatch that opened the refresh pull request on 2026-10-28: runs sat at action_required, no oracle-verdict run existed, and after approval the test job failed on the inventory mismatch. The baseline directory became an oracle-reviewed soundness path in the blocking duration gate change, so refresh pull requests now also need a verdict. Fix candidates: have the workflow regenerate the inventory in the same commit, open the pull request with a token or app whose events trigger workflows, and dispatch the oracle verdict for it.
description: The weekly baseline refresh opens its pull request with the workflow token, so GitHub holds the pull request's workflow runs at action_required and no oracle verdict is triggered until a maintainer approves the runs and dispatches the oracle by hand. After that, the pull request still fails the fast tests: the docs reference inventory (quality/docs-reference-inventory.json) counts occurrences of doc paths inside tests/fixtures/fast_tier_baseline/tests-*.json, so every refresh changes the inventory and test_doc_reference_inventory fails until the inventory is regenerated. The refresh also branches from develop at that moment, so a red develop is inherited.
